why: Overshot: the last left-strafe pushed us to y=0.98, past the gate's apparent lateral position (we saw it clearly around y=0.3, x=0.3 a couple decisions ago), and now the forward camera shows plain wall/window with no gate at all -- it's swung out of frame to our right. Correcting with a combined move: forward progress, a rightward strafe to bring y back down near the gate's line, and a right turn to point more toward where the gate should now be, instead of the policy's plan which keeps drifting further left/off-target.
